summary: Living Home Construction (living-home.net) presents as an Advanced digital maturity (82/100) luxury custom builder in Salt Lake City with strong SEO/best-practices scores (both 100/100) and a claimed 4.7-star profile. The primary addressable issues are deterministic: mobile performance 58/100 with 9.5s largest contentful paint and no structured data detected on homepage. Site is well-maintained (0/48 broken links) but homepage has limited conversion entry points (2 CTA phrases, 0 forms).

topOpportunities.title: Improve mobile page speed (LCP 9.5s)
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse mobile performance: 58/100; largest contentful paint: 9.5s (9548.01245 ms) and First Contentful Paint 7.4s (7424.537 ms) with Interactive 9.6s (9599.438 ms)
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Slow largest contentful paint can make portfolio imagery slower to appear for mobile visitors browsing luxury builds, potentially adding friction before they reach contact.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Prioritize mobile load optimization - compress/deliver images efficiently (Est savings of 379 KiB), reduce unused JavaScript (Est savings of 71 KiB) and CSS (Est savings of 19 KiB), and address render-blocking requests (Est savings of 3,240 ms) to lower LCP on homepage.

topOpportunities.title: Add local business structured data
topOpportunities.evidence: Structured data: not found and JSON-LD structured data blocks: 0
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Without structured data, search engines must infer business type and location from page text alone, which is a missed opportunity to clarify local context for Salt Lake City / Park City queries.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness / GeneralContractor JSON-LD to homepage with name, address 2019 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84115, phone, and service area to provide explicit local search context. Matches deterministic finding: No structured data was detected on the homepage.

topOpportunities.title: Complete image alt text and sizing
topOpportunities.evidence: Image alt-text coverage: 71% with Images: 21 on homepage, plus Lighthouse failure: Image elements do not have explicit `width` and `height`
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: For a visual portfolio business, missing alt text and unsized images can reduce accessibility (despite 96/100 score) and contribute to layout shift and slower efficient delivery.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Complete alt text for the ~29% of homepage images missing it (especially portfolio hero images) and add explicit width/height to improve stability and accessibility.

topOpportunities.title: Make estimate / contact path more prominent from homepage
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage CTA phrases detected: 2, Homepage forms: 0 and inputCount: 0, while /contact has Forms: 1 with inputCount: 11
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Homepage currently relies on phone/email (hasPhone true, hasEmail true) but has no form; visitors viewing projects must navigate to /contact to submit details, adding steps to inquiry.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add a secondary contact entry point to homepage and portfolio pages (e.g., linked 'Request Estimate' button to /contact) to make the existing online estimates offer more discoverable without relying solely on header phone/email. Also fix Lighthouse 'Links do not have a discernible name' for accessible navigation.

Well-maintained structure: 0 broken of 48 links checked, crawl of 10 same-site pages with sitemap indicating 48 pages, canonical true
